snippet.title: NOTHING IS KNOWN - TRAILER
snippet.description:
DEMO COMING SOON!

Discover our first new game! Not your “usual” murder case, but the frantic search for a missing little girl.

🔍Genre: Narrative Adventure, Puzzle.
🎮Mechanics: QTE, multiple choice dialogues, side scrollers, puzzles.

🔗Useful links:
